questions.q: Explain one reason why the CPI may not measure changes in the cost of living accurately.

ideas.label: It's based on an average basket, or can't fully allow for quality or new products
So it doesn't match what a given household buys, or prices don't show the real change

questions.model: The CPI uses an average basket, while real households buy different things. So their own cost of living can change by more or less than the index.
questions.why: Averages hide the differences between households.

tests.answer: It uses an average basket, but households spend differently, so it does not reflect their costs.
